## For translators

Download one file for the environment you use.

| Environment | What to download |
| ---- | ---- |
| macOS (Apple Silicon) | `darwin_arm64.tar.gz` |
| macOS (Intel) | `darwin_amd64.tar.gz` |
| Windows (ordinary PC) | `windows_amd64.zip` |
| Windows (arm64 machine) | `windows_arm64.zip` |
| Linux | `linux_amd64.tar.gz` |
| Linux (arm64 machine) | `linux_arm64.tar.gz` |

`darwin` means macOS.
If you are not sure which one you are on, you can check as follows.

- On macOS and Linux, run `uname -m`. `arm64` means arm64 and `x86_64` means amd64
- On Windows, look at "System type" under "Settings" → "System" → "About"

The steps to extract and run it, and what to do when macOS or Windows blocks it, are in the [README](https://github.com/223n/dragnwash-localization-editor/blob/main/README.en.md#download).

`checksums.txt` is there to check that the archive you downloaded is not corrupted.
It is not proof that the distributor is genuine.
